meta.title: Meta Tools
meta.description: Integrated meta-library (.dsh) plugin for models: task routing with a cold-start plan, revision signing (revlog), the project task-type registry, model-identity aliases, theme presets, prompt injection for the main agent (public/meta) and for delegated children (configurable meta/SUBAGENTS.md), a vendored tool-search disclosure engine with a session-frozen catalog, and its own Meta-tools settings column.
